# kion_azure_account (Resource)

Manages a Kion Azure Account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_azure_account" "example" {
  # Required
  account_name   = "example"
  payer_id       = 1
  project_id     = 1
  start_datecode = "2026-01"

  # Optional
  # account_alias        = "example"
  # account_type_id      = 1
  # skip_access_checking = false
  # subscription_uuid    = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String) Name of the account in the application.
- `payer_id` (Number) ID of the payer (aka Azure Tenant) where this subscription can be found
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project the account belongs to. Changing it moves the account in place through POST /v3/account/{id}/move rather than recreating it: Kion gives the account a new id, the resource adopts it, and the account's financial history stays with the old project (the move's preserve setting). The new project's cloud rules and cloud access roles apply after the move. Requires permission to manage accounts and projects.
- `start_datecode` (String) Date when the Azure subscription will begin submitting payments against a funding source (YYYY-MM)

### Optional

- `account_alias` (String) Alias of the account in the application.
- `account_type_id` (Number) The Account Type ID is the corresponding account's type.
3 - Azure CSP Standard
6 - Azure EA
7 - Azure EA Government
8 - Azure CSP Standard Resource Group
9 - Azure EA Resource Group
10 - Azure EA Government Resource Group
11 - Azure CSP Government
12 - Azure CSP Government Resource Group
Will default to 3 if not given.
- `skip_access_checking` (Boolean) When true, the application does not perform periodic access validation. Default is false.
- `subscription_uuid` (String) Azure Subscription UUID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Account ID.
